content: In the letter to Titus, what does Paul call Titus?
explanation: They shared a common faith. “To Titus, my true child in our common faith” (Titus 1:4, BSB)

content: In Titus, what has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone?
explanation: Salvation is for all. “For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.” (Titus 2:11, BSB)

content: In Titus, Paul tells Titus to show himself an example by doing what?
explanation: Teach with integrity. “In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works.” (Titus 2:7, BSB)

content: In Titus, on which island did Paul leave Titus?
explanation: To appoint elders in every town. “The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished” (Titus 1:5, BSB)

content: In Titus, God saved us not by our deeds but according to His what?
explanation: Through new birth by the Spirit. “He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy” (Titus 3:5, BSB)

content: In Titus, whom was Titus to appoint in every town of Crete?
explanation: To set the churches in order. “and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.” (Titus 1:5, BSB)

content: In Titus, where did Paul plan to spend the winter?
explanation: He asked Titus to come there. “make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.” (Titus 3:12, BSB)

content: In Titus, whom did Paul plan to send, Artemas or whom?
explanation: Then Titus could come to Paul. “As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you” (Titus 3:12, BSB)
